_notes: Vendor-neutral draft. Map 'options[].label' and 'options[].description' to the field names your API expects (Decision-1 and Jev differ; check each vendor's docs).
Input: extracted text of the first 1-2 pages of ONE file, after the text-layer check has passed.
Classes are drawn to match processing branches. Merge or split wherever your branches differ.
Anything below your confidence threshold on 'document_type', or with 'multiple_documents' = yes, should leave the automated path.
instruction: You are classifying a single document produced in discovery in a Texas family law case. Decide based only on the text provided. If the text does not clearly fit an option, choose other_unknown.

options.label: bank_statement
options.description: Periodic statement for a checking, savings, or money market deposit account showing deposits, withdrawals, and balances.

options.label: credit_card_statement
options.description: Periodic statement for a credit or charge card showing purchases, payments, interest, and balance due.

options.label: brokerage_statement
options.description: Periodic statement for a taxable investment account showing holdings, trades, dividends, and market value.

options.label: retirement_statement
options.description: Statement for a 401(k), 403(b), IRA, pension, or other retirement or deferred compensation plan.

options.label: loan_statement
options.description: Statement or payoff letter for a mortgage, HELOC, auto loan, student loan, or other installment or revolving loan that is not a credit card.

options.label: payment_app_record
options.description: Transaction history from a payment or crypto platform such as Venmo, Zelle, PayPal, Cash App, or Coinbase.

options.label: individual_tax_return
options.description: Personal income tax return (Form 1040 and attached schedules) or an IRS account or return transcript for an individual.

options.label: business_tax_return
options.description: Entity tax return such as Form 1120, 1120-S, 1065, or a Texas franchise tax report.

options.label: tax_information_form
options.description: Standalone information form such as a W-2, 1099, 1098, or Schedule K-1, not attached to a full return.

options.label: pay_stub
options.description: Paycheck stub or earnings statement showing gross pay, deductions, and net pay for a pay period.

options.label: employment_record
options.description: Offer letter, employment agreement, benefits summary, equity or bonus award, performance review, or personnel file document.

options.label: business_financial_statement
options.description: Profit and loss statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, general ledger, or trial balance for a business.

options.label: business_governance_record
options.description: Company agreement, bylaws, certificate of formation, minutes, ownership ledger, or cap table for a business entity.

options.label: invoice_or_bill
options.description: Request for payment from a vendor, utility, school, medical provider, or other business, itemizing amounts owed.

options.label: receipt
options.description: Proof of a completed purchase or payment, such as a store receipt or order confirmation showing amount paid.

options.label: real_property_record
options.description: Deed, deed of trust, closing or settlement statement, appraisal district record, survey, or lease for real estate.

options.label: title_or_registration
options.description: Certificate of title or registration for a vehicle, boat, trailer, aircraft, or other titled personal property.

options.label: appraisal_or_valuation
options.description: Appraisal or valuation report for real estate, a business interest, jewelry, art, or other property.

options.label: insurance_record
options.description: Insurance policy, declarations page, cash-value statement, claim record, or beneficiary designation.

options.label: estate_planning_document
options.description: Will, trust instrument, power of attorney, or trust account statement or accounting.

options.label: contract_or_agreement
options.description: Signed or draft agreement not covered above, such as a premarital or marital property agreement, promissory note, or purchase contract.

options.label: inventory_and_appraisement
options.description: A party's sworn inventory and appraisement or other schedule listing assets, liabilities, and claimed separate property.

options.label: court_filing
options.description: Pleading, motion, order, decree, or other document filed in or issued by a court.

options.label: discovery_instrument
options.description: Discovery request, written response, objection, privilege log, or deposition transcript.

options.label: email
options.description: Email message or thread with sender, recipient, date, and subject headers.

options.label: text_message
options.description: SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp, or similar chat messages, whether exported as text or captured as a transcript.

options.label: coparenting_app_record
options.description: Messages, calendar entries, or expense logs exported from a co-parenting app such as OurFamilyWizard, AppClose, or TalkingParents.

options.label: social_media_content
options.description: Post, comment, profile, or direct message from a social media or dating platform.

options.label: letter_or_correspondence
options.description: Formal letter or notice on paper or letterhead that is not an email, including demand letters and agency notices.

options.label: drug_or_alcohol_test_result
options.description: Laboratory or monitoring report of drug or alcohol testing, including hair, nail, urine, PEth, or remote breath-testing reports.

options.label: medical_record
options.description: Treatment record, visit summary, prescription record, or billing record from a medical or dental provider.

options.label: mental_health_record
options.description: Record from a therapist, counselor, psychologist, psychiatrist, or substance abuse treatment provider, including evaluations.

options.label: school_or_childcare_record
options.description: Report card, attendance record, disciplinary record, special education document, or enrollment record for a child.

options.label: law_enforcement_or_cps_record
options.description: Police report, incident report, arrest record, protective order record, or child protective services record.

options.label: calendar_or_log
options.description: Calendar, journal, diary, possession log, or timeline kept by a person to record events.

options.label: summary_or_spreadsheet
options.description: Table, spreadsheet, or summary prepared by a party or professional to compile or analyze other records.

options.label: photo_or_image
options.description: Photograph or image with little or no meaningful text, or only a caption or filename.

options.label: other_unknown
options.description: Does not clearly fit any other option, or the text is too sparse or garbled to tell.

multiple_documents.question: Does this file appear to contain more than one distinct document?

multiple_accounts.question: If this is an account statement, does it cover more than one account or account number?

transaction_detail_present.question: Does the document list individual dated transactions, as opposed to only summary totals or balances?

business_or_entity_owner.question: Is the account, return, or record in the name of a business, trust, or other entity rather than an individual?

annual_or_year_end.question: Is this an annual or year-end summary rather than a monthly or quarterly statement?

attorney_involved.question: Is an attorney or law firm a sender, recipient, or author of this document?

involves_child.question: Does the document primarily concern a minor child?

non_english.question: Is a substantial portion of the text in a language other than English?

text_quality.question: How clean and complete is the extracted text, where 0 is unreadable and 100 is clean native text?
